/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

// Exports the contents of a grid (using the selected order and filters) to an Excel file.
LoadWWPContext.Call(&WWPContext)

Do 'OpenDocument'

&CellRow = 1
&FirstColumn = 1

Do 'LoadGridState'

Do 'WriteFilters'

Do 'WriteColumnTitles'

Do 'WriteData'

Do 'CloseDocument'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */


Sub 'OpenDocument'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	&Random = Random() * 10000
	&Filename = !"wcBobinasPorExtrusionExport-" + &Random.ToString().Trim() + !".xlsx"

	&ExcelDocument.Open(&Filename)
	Do 'CheckStatus'
	&ExcelDocument.Clear()

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'WriteFilters'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	If not (&FilterFullText.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "WWP_FullTextFilterDescription")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(&FilterFullText)
	EndIf
	If not &GridConditionalFormattingFilter.IsEmpty()
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "WWP_FullTextFilterDescription")
		Do Case
			Case &GridConditionalFormattingFilter = 1
				&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = "En Proceso"
			Case &GridConditionalFormattingFilter = 2
				&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = "Disponible"
			Case &GridConditionalFormattingFilter = 3
				&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = "En Prensado"
			Case &GridConditionalFormattingFilter = 4
				&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = "Pausada"
			Case &GridConditionalFormattingFilter = 5
				&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = "En Reposo"
			Case &GridConditionalFormattingFilter = 6
				&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = "Molino"
		EndCase
	EndIf
	&CellRow += 2

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'WriteColumnTitles'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	&VisibleColumnCount = 0
	If &Session.Get(!'Produccion.wcBobinasPorExtrusionColumnsSelector') <> ''
		&ColumnsSelectorXML = &Session.Get(!'Produccion.wcBobinasPorExtrusionColumnsSelector')
		&ColumnsSelector.FromXml(&ColumnsSelectorXML)
	Else
		Do 'InitializeColumnsSelector'
	EndIf

	&ColumnsSelector.Columns.Sort(!'Order')
	For &ColumnsSelector_Column in &ColumnsSelector.Columns
		If &ColumnsSelector_Column.IsVisible = True
			&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = GetMessageText(iif(&ColumnsSelector_Column.DisplayName.IsEmpty(), &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName, &ColumnsSelector_Column.DisplayName))
			&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Bold = True
			&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Color = 11
			&VisibleColumnCount += 1
		EndIf
	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'WriteData'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	//&SDTBobina must be loaded manually before this code
	
	For &SDTBobinaItem in &SDTBobina

		// Write cell values
		&CellRow += 1
		
		Do 'BeforeWriteLine'
		&VisibleColumnCount = 0
		For &ColumnsSelector_Column in &ColumnsSelector.Columns
			If &ColumnsSelector_Column.IsVisible = True
				Do Case
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'SDTBobina__ExtrusionId'
						
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Number = &SDTBobinaItem.ExtrusionId
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'SDTBobina__BobinaOrigen'
						
						&BobinaOrigenAux = &SDTBobinaItem.BobinaOrigen
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = &BobinaOrigenAux.EnumerationDescription()
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'SDTBobina__BobinaHoraInicio'
						
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Date = &SDTBobinaItem.BobinaHoraInicio
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'SDTBobina__BobinaHoraSalida'
						
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Date = &SDTBobinaItem.BobinaHoraSalida
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'SDTBobina__BobinaNo'
						
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Number = &SDTBobinaItem.BobinaNo
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'SDTBobina__BobinaNoSerie'
						
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(&SDTBobinaItem.BobinaNoSerie)
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'SDTBobina__BobinaKg'
						
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Number = &SDTBobinaItem.BobinaKg
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'SDTBobina__BobinaMermaKg'
						
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Number = &SDTBobinaItem.BobinaMermaKg
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'SDTBobina__BobinaEspesor'
						
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Number = &SDTBobinaItem.BobinaEspesor
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'SDTBobina__BobinaObservaciones'
						
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(&SDTBobinaItem.BobinaObservaciones)
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'SDTBobina__BobinaMotivoMolino'
						
						&BobinaMotivoMolinoAux = &SDTBobinaItem.BobinaMotivoMolino
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = &BobinaMotivoMolinoAux.EnumerationDescription()
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'SDTBobina__BobinaProductoNombre'
						
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(&SDTBobinaItem.BobinaProductoNombre)
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'SDTBobina__BobinaCarreras'
						
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Number = &SDTBobinaItem.BobinaCarreras
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'SDTBobina__BobinaIniciaReposo'
						
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Date = &SDTBobinaItem.BobinaIniciaReposo
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'SDTBobina__BobinaMinutosEnReposo'
						
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Number = &SDTBobinaItem.BobinaMinutosEnReposo
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'SDTBobina__BobinaMolino'
						
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = &SDTBobinaItem.BobinaMolino.ToString()
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'SDTBobina__BobinaEtiqueta'
						
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(&SDTBobinaItem.BobinaEtiqueta)
				EndCase
				&VisibleColumnCount += 1
			EndIf
		EndFor		
		
		Do 'AfterWriteLine'

	Endfor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'CloseDocument'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	&ExcelDocument.Save()
	Do 'CheckStatus'
	&ExcelDocument.Close()

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'CheckStatus'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	If (&ExcelDocument.ErrCode <> 0)
		&Filename = ""
		&ErrorMessage = &ExcelDocument.ErrDescription
		&ExcelDocument.Close()
		Return
	EndIf

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'InitializeColumnsSelector'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	&ColumnsSelector = new WWPBaseObjects.WWPColumnsSelector()
	WWP_ColumnsSelector_Add(&ColumnsSelector, !"SDTBobina__ExtrusionId", '', !'Extrusión ID', True, '')

	WWP_ColumnsSelector_Add(&ColumnsSelector, !"SDTBobina__BobinaEspesor", '', !'Bobina Espesor', True, '')
	WWP_ColumnsSelector_Add(&ColumnsSelector, !"SDTBobina__BobinaObservaciones", '', !'Bobina Observaciones', True, '')

	WWP_ColumnsSelector_Add(&ColumnsSelector, !"SDTBobina__BobinaProductoNombre", '', !'Bobina Producto Nombre', True, '')
	WWP_ColumnsSelector_Add(&ColumnsSelector, !"SDTBobina__BobinaCarreras", '', !'Bobina Carreras', True, '')
	WWP_ColumnsSelector_Add(&ColumnsSelector, !"SDTBobina__BobinaIniciaReposo", '', !'Bobina Inicia Reposo', True, '')
	WWP_ColumnsSelector_Add(&ColumnsSelector, !"SDTBobina__BobinaMinutosEnReposo", '', !'Bobina Minutos En Reposo', True, '')
